evidence_boundary: Retrospective method development/protocol sensitivity only. Historical T-cell outer labels were previously inspected. Not a new blind test, independent study, or prospective confirmation. No unviewed same-endpoint surface exists in current assets (Castillo 50nt contexts all inspected; N25 excluded by frozen external protocol; PERSIST-seq inspected).
hypothesis: Within the identical frozen nested proposal prefix, selecting argmax(proxy_mean - kappa*proxy_std) with kappa>0 reduces cap16 measured-MRL regret relative to frozen BoN (kappa=0). Because the prefix is fixed, opportunity loss is unchanged by construction and any effect is purely within-tail ranking; because scores are frozen, global MAE/Spearman are unchanged by construction.

method.proxy_std_definition: sample standard deviation ddof=1 across the three member predictions (matches src/proxy_function_gap/inference.py ensemble_std)
method.proxy_std_source_target: frozen proxy_std field in paper1_v3_strict_h1_retry1 cnn_scores JSON records
method.selection_rule: first occurrence of maximum s_kappa within the frozen proposal prefix (np.argmax, identical to frozen BoN tie rule)

auxiliary.pools_proposals: reuse frozen dev/test pools and proposals .npy from tcell_residual_bstrict_v1 direction directories verbatim (SHA256-pinned); no rebuild
auxiliary.identity_check: kappa=0 dev/test cap16_mean_regret must exactly equal residual v1 selection.json baseline values in both directions
auxiliary.gate: chosen kappa test cap16 mean regret strictly lower than kappa=0 in BOTH directions; any failure stops the experiment without reading T-cell MRL
auxiliary.diagnostics: destination dev pools only: per-pool top16 by frozen proxy_mean (index tie-break); Spearman(proxy_std, p-y) and Spearman(proxy_std, |p-y|); reported regardless of outcome; never used for selection

target_evaluation.permitted_only_if: auxiliary_gate_passed.json exists with both directions passing
target_evaluation.prefix_reconstruction: paper1_budget_matched_v1/PROTOCOL.md frozen _draw_index nested proposal prefixes, seeds 101/202/303/404/505
target_evaluation.primary_contrast: UPTS(kappa*) cap16 minus frozen-BoN cap16 per-pool mean measured-MRL regret; negative favors UPTS
controls: frozen 4-mer MLP BoN (simple baseline; no additive ridge exists for T-cell, disclosed)
target_evaluation.bootstrap_seed: 20261128 + 100*context_index + cap_index, context order [defined_tcell_r1, defined_tcell_r2], cap order [1,2,4,8,16]
target_evaluation.multiplicity: per-context 10-row Holm family (caps 1/2/4/8/16 plus cap1 deterministic zero rows with p=1), secondary caps only; primary cap16 judged by section 8.3 joint criteria
success_criteria_section_8_3: r1 and r2 cap16 point estimates both < 0
pooled two-context pool-cluster bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0
per-context absolute reduction >= max(0.1 MRL, 5% of frozen baseline mean BoN16 regret); thresholds frozen in frozen_thresholds.json from pinned budget results.json
target_evaluation.failure_rule: any criterion unmet => not proven substantive improvement; retain all values; no cap/subset/kappa switching; this frozen test ends
target_evaluation.mechanism_attribution: opportunity loss identical by construction; delta regret entirely within-tail ranking loss; report per-pool demoted/promoted candidate proxy_std, within-tail loss change, turnover; global MAE/Spearman unchanged by construction

compute: CPU-only statistics and record reconstruction; no training, no inference, no GPU; all scores frozen. Labeled per execution prompt hard constraint 4.
